thread.title: Apple buys maker of augmented-reality lenses: report

author: Mike Murphy
title: Apple buys maker of augmented-reality lenses: report
text:
Apple Inc. AAPL, +1.49% confirmed it has acquired a small Colorado company that makes lenses for augmented-reality glasses, Reuters reported late Wednesday. Besides making displays, Akonia Holographics also holds more than 200 patents related to holographic technology, Reuters said. The company has raised about $11.6 million in funding, according to Crunchbase . Last year, Bloomberg News reported Apple could release an augmented-reality headset in 2020, and in June, the iPhone-maker announced new AR capabilities for its next mobile operating system, iOS 12. After closing up 1.5% Wednesday, Apple shares edged up 0.4% in after-hours trading.
